_comment: Pipeline source manifest. The ONLY place institutions, programmes and disciplines appear: the engine treats every field as opaque data. Adding a university, programme or discipline = adding an entry here (and its PDF under data/raw), never a code change. role: TARGET = curriculum being analysed; PREVIOUS_VERSION = an earlier version of the SAME programme (enables drift); REFERENCE = reference/model curriculum used as comparison evidence (not ground truth); PEER = official curriculum of another institution, decoded by the same generic decoder and used ONLY by the peer benchmark (never by target analytics). industry_sources = supplied job-posting files; taxonomy_sources = ESCO files. All sources must be original files under data/raw (evidence_guard).
